Name: A Shooter
Overview: A Shooter is a space based 2D side-scrolling flight game that over the course of 13 levels, pits the player's attack fighter up against waves of enemy fighters, with each level getting progressively harder. At the climax of each level, the player will be pitted against a boss. The player only has one life per game and it does not contain any king of visual health indicator. As with similar games, the player will receive points based how many enemies and bosses killed, the harder the enemies, the more points are awarded. High scores are also tracked globally. Throughout the game, power-ups can be obtained and collected, and unlike power-ups in most games they are permanent. A Shooter also features co-operative gameplay for up to four people.
